# ToastController

> Creates and manages toast notifications via the global toast manager.

## Methods

| Method |
|--------|
| `toast()` |
| `dismissToast()` |
| `dismissAllToasts()` |
| `destroy()` |

## Usage

```ts
import { ToastController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new ToastController(element);
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
